Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent adopted a flawed verification method and an ill-chosen candidate list. They hardcoded a small set of eateries (including one far away at Foxwoods) without ensuring proximity to Harkness Memorial State Park, violating the plan to identify the closest options. Their “check_operating_hours” relied on finding the exact string “11:00 PM” in generic web search snippets, which would miss businesses listed as “Open 24 hours” or “Open until 12 AM,” such as the nearby McDonald’s. This brittle approach and lack of location filtering led to false negatives and ultimately missing the correct answer.
